result.instructions: Tools for Interparcel, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Track parcel GB9999999999 and tell me where it is."; "Get shipping quotes for a 2 kg parcel from Crawley to Paris."; "List my shipments that are on hold and their validation errors.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Interparcel data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run interparcel_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run interparcel_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run interparcel_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. interparcel_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: interparcel_track_parcel
tools.title: Track a parcel
tools.description: Track a parcel by its 12-digit Interparcel tracking number. Returns the current tracking events. Interparcel API: GET /tracking/{trackingNumber}.

trackingNumber.description: The 12-character Interparcel tracking number, for example GB9999999999.

tools.name: interparcel_get_quote
tools.title: Get shipping quote
tools.description: READ ONLY: price the available services for one or more parcels between two addresses. Books nothing and takes no payment. Use the service names and pickup dates it returns when you create an order or shipment. Interparcel API: POST /quote.

state.description: State or province, where the country needs one.

country.description: Country name or ISO country code, for example GB, AU, NZ, FR.

state.description: State or province, where the country needs one.

country.description: Country name or ISO country code, for example GB, AU, NZ, FR.

filter.description: Optional filters on the quote results.

carriers.description: Carrier names, for example DX or Parcelforce.

tools.name: interparcel_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one booked order by its Interparcel order id: status (processing, booked or requires_staff_attention), tracking numbers, price and label status. Interparcel API: GET /orders/{orderId}.

orderId.description: The Interparcel order id returned when the order was created.

tools.name: interparcel_search_shipments
tools.title: Search shipments
tools.description: READ ONLY: search shipments in Shipping Manager by text or structured filters (status ready, incomplete or on_hold; created and pickup date ranges; reference; names; countries). Paged. Interparcel API: POST /shipments/search.

query.description: Free text: shipment id, reference, names, addresses, contents.

country.description: Country name or ISO code (exact match).

tools.name: interparcel_get_shipment
tools.title: Get a shipment
tools.description: Get one shipment from Shipping Manager by its shipment id: status (ready, incomplete or on_hold), addresses, parcels, selected service, price and validation errors. Interparcel API: GET /shipments/{shipmentId}.

shipmentId.description: The shipment id, for example S260921-A8V53CNvn63F.

tools.name: interparcel_list_saved_cards
tools.title: List saved cards
tools.description: List the saved payment cards on the account (id, brand, last four digits, expiry). Use an id as payment.cardId when you create an order. Interparcel API: GET /account/saved-cards.

tools.name: interparcel_get_prepay_balance
tools.title: Get PrePay balance
tools.description: Get the current PrePay balance and currency of the account. Interparcel API: GET /account/prepay/balance.

tools.name: interparcel_create_order
tools.title: Create and pay for courier orders
tools.description: WRITE, COSTS MONEY: books 1 to 20 courier orders and charges the payment method (saved card or PrePay). Each order books a paid courier job. Get the service and a pickup date from interparcel_get_quote first. Use a unique idempotencyKey (8 to 100 characters): repeating the same request with the same key returns the first result and charges nothing again. Interparcel API: POST /orders (version 2).

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key for this booking, 8 to 100 characters. Strongly recommended.

tools.name: interparcel_add_shipment
tools.title: Add a shipment to Shipping Manager
tools.description: WRITE: imports one shipment into Shipping Manager for later booking. It does not book a courier and takes no payment. With validate true (default) the import fails on any validation error; set validate false to import an incomplete shipment for correction. Interparcel API: POST /shipments/add (version 3).

validate.description: Default true. false imports an incomplete shipment and returns its validation errors.
